What We Plan for Greek Life

Chapter Formals & Semis

From Nashville to New Orleans, we plan unforgettable formal weekends on a per-person budget.

Spring Break Trips

We find the best all-inclusive resorts in destinations like Mexico and the DR for the ultimate chapter getaway.

Destination Weekends

Looking for a unique brotherhood or sisterhood trip? We'll plan a custom weekend in an exciting city.

Alumni Reunions

Bring your alumni together for Homecoming or a milestone reunion with professionally managed travel and events.

Book a Free Discovery Call

The Easiest Planning Process Ever

1. Individual Invoicing & Plans

No more chasing down money. Members get personalized links and pay their own invoices. Plus, we offer flexible payment plans that work with tight budgets.

2. Personalized Info Packets

Custom packing lists for your destination, detailed itineraries, dress codes, required forms, emergency contacts, and insider tips—all personalized for your trip.

3. On-Site Event Support

Planning for 100+ members? We can travel with your chapter to handle check-ins, room assignments, and any issues that come up.

From Big Ideas to Flawless Execution

Venue & Hotel Selection

We find the perfect hotels and venues that fit your budget and vibe, and we handle all the booking and negotiations.

Detailed Itineraries

We build a full schedule, from flights and transport to dinners and excursions, so everyone knows where to be and when.

Clear Communication

We keep everyone on track with reminders about deadlines for payment, forms, and any other important info.

Let's Start Planning

Legendary Events, Lifelong Friendships

The Ultimate Chapter Experience

Planning a formal or spring break trip comes with huge expectations. We take the pressure off your shoulders by managing every detail, from finding the perfect resort to coordinating travel for everyone. Our goal is simple: to help you plan a seamless, unforgettable event that becomes a core memory for your chapter.

Secure Your Most Valuable Relationships

The strongest brotherhoods and sisterhoods are built on shared experiences. When you're not worried about logistics, you can focus on what really matters: connecting with each other. We create the perfect backdrop for the inside jokes, late-night talks, and genuine fun that will strengthen your chapter for years to come.

“Mandy was absolutely incredible to work with for our senior college spring break trip to Breathless Riviera Cancun. Mandy helped us secure a reputable resort with amazing amenities that truly made the trip unforgettable. I will definitely be using Mandy again!”
